candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Intern Consultant Data Science and AI
letter.greeting: Dear Ms Kern, dear Ms Hartmuth,
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship as Intern Consultant Data Science and AI in the Insurance Analytics Platform team. The role combines what I have done so far, turning business data into reports people use, with the machine learning I am studying now.
letter.profile_intro: I am in the first semester of my M.Sc. Data Science at TU Ilmenau, after a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I have worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I fine-tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model in PyTorch that reached 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image retinal OCT test set
I turned business requirements into KPI dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and supported around 30 dashboards used across HR, finance and supply chain
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who then purchased it

letter.problems_section: I would explore datasets, build and document analyses and help turn use cases into working prototypes, both classic data science and generative AI. My machine learning experience comes from projects, not production, so I would bring solid Python and data handling and learn your insurance context quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I hold a German residence permit for study; I will confirm the internship period against its work-day limits with you. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
